notes: A demand-side buyer request that name-drops 'coming soon' inventory. Primary intent = BUYER_ISO (a buyer's need), NOT COMING_SOON_SALE. Watch for the classifier latching onto 'coming soon' and routing supply-side; there must be no address leakage.

input.subject: Buyer looking for coming-soon Tribeca 2BRs before they hit the market
input.bodyText:
Hi all,

I have a serious buyer client who is ready to move quickly and wants to get ahead of the market. They're specifically hunting for a 2BR in Tribeca under $3M, and they'd love to see anything coming soon before it hits the open market.

If any of you have pre-market or coming-soon inventory in Tribeca that fits, please flag it for me directly. My buyer is pre-approved and can move on the right place fast.

Appreciate anyone who can point me toward off-the-radar 2BRs down there.

Best,
Danielle
